data.title: 诱宵美九 · 学院黄昏长廊的水手服浅唱
data.description: 放学后的私立凛道女子学院，美九身穿深蓝优雅水手服漫步于空旷木质走廊，指尖划过窗框，轻哼动人旋律。
data.location: 贵族女子学院古典长廊
data.action: 抱书漫步在长廊中央，侧颜微扬，唇瓣微张轻哼旋律，双马尾随步伐轻摆
data.lighting: 走廊长窗投下的斜长金红色夕阳，在地板上切割出温暖几何光影
data.camera: 中景纵深构图，长廊透视感突出宁静悠长的氛围
data.promptProse: Miku Izayoi strolls unhurried down the polished wooden hallway of Rindo Academy after class, hugging a stack of textbooks to her chest. Dressed in her dignified dark-navy school sailor uniform, her long twin-tails sway rhythmically with each graceful step. Golden afternoon sunbeams slice horizontally through the tall multi-paned windows, framing her delicate profile as she softly hums a melody.
data.animaCaption: Hugging her textbooks to her chest, Miku hums a gentle melody as she walks along the sun-striped academy corridor.
